data.gender_notes: Shaquib is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shaquib is derived from the Arabic word 'shukr' meaning 'thankful' and 'ibn' meaning 'son'. The name is believed to signify a child who is a gift from God, a blessing bestowed upon his parents. The name Shaquib carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Urdu. Parents who choose Shaquib usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
